name: Y'all Street Physical Silver ETF
desc: The fund is not actively managed. It does not engage in any activities designed to obtain a profit from, or to compensate investors for losses caused by, changes in the price of silver. It holds Physical Silver. The fund receives Physical Silver deposited by Authorized Participants in exchange for the creation of Baskets and delivers Physical Silver to Authorized Participants in exchange for Baskets surrendered to it for redemption.
